name: Rounded Wooden Shelf
description: A compact, curved wooden shelf built for a small cluster of decorative pieces rather than a long display run. The rounded profile keeps the edges soft, and each tier holds a handful of items, good for a corner, an alcove, or anywhere a large flat shelf would feel out of scale.
highlights: Compact, rounded profile suited to corners and smaller wall spaces
Multiple tiers for grouping smaller decorative items
Softer, more casual alternative to a straight-edged shelf
installation: Once the file is installed and inZOI is running, open Build Mode and switch to the Furniture catalog. Search for "Rounded Wooden Shelf" to find the piece, it is listed under that name in the build menu, not under "MOOSTYLES." If it does not show up, confirm the mod is enabled in your mod manager and that you are on the tracked game version listed above before reporting it as missing.

fileManifest.description: A simple curved and rounded wooden shelf for decorative pieces. Holds up to 20+ items total.
